scope_note: Standalone OPT-30B MLP. Per-CCD latency includes persistent-worker synchronization, PACE fused block computation, publication of partial outputs, and cross-CCD reduction; process/thread and model setup is excluded. Thread variants record their reduction strategy and per-worker operator imbalance.
limitations: The matrix may contain process-based and persistent-pthread prototypes of the PACE v1.0 split-loop TODO; neither patches the PACE kernel.
Per-CCD latency includes synchronization, partial-output publication, and final reduction, but excludes worker/thread and weight setup.
The 32 MiB fit calculation applies to one active split block plus input and intermediate activation on one CCD.
TPP/global and per-CCD variants run in separate serialized Slurm tasks; confidence intervals therefore use independent samples.
